title: Ship readiness is a content question, not a history one
description: ship readiness is a content question, not a history one
acceptance_criteria: A change whose verification commit was destroyed by a squash-merge, with its content unchanged, reports ready_to_finalize with no blockers. Evidence whose workspace digest does not match the tree still reads as stale. The discriminating test fails on a binary built from a separate checkout at db36230a with ready_to_finalize false and the ancestry blocker present.
